description: Flametongue Totem 275 Mana Instant Requires Shaman Requires level 58 Tools: Fire Totem Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes (1363 / 77 * 1 - 1) to (1363 / 25 * 1 ) additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.
name: Flametongue Totem
